findings.summary: L3-relevant DRIFT: OutputSanitizer/PIIDetector/PromptInjectionFilter have zero call sites in engine path; only admission control runs (worker.rs:117-127, inference.rs:156-164); ARCHITECTURE_PLAN data flow overstates behavior; wire + measure governance overhead before perf claims

mistral.rs BLOCKED for linking: mistralrs-core unconditionally deps reqwest, tokio-tungstenite (WebSocket), hf-hub, mistralrs-mcp; plus git-candle 0.11 pin vs our 0.8; runtime-offline capable but link-time incompatible

mistral.rs = pattern donor: speculative proposer/verifier/staging/driver (maps ~1:1 to ADR-007 traits; interleaved verify-then-draft; stochastic rejection sampling), scheduler length-bucketing continuous batching, PrefixCacheManagerV2, ISQ, FP8 paged-KV, decode-only CUDA graphs

GGUF backend sets only n_ctx/n_threads/n_threads_batch/n_gpu_layers (backend.rs:229-232, 37); flash-attn policy, type_k/type_v Q8_0 KV, n_batch/n_ubatch, offload_kqv, mmap all available at pinned 0.1.133 and unused; all LlamaBatch n_seq=1; scheduler RequestBatch dead code (worker.rs:68-70); sampler seed hardcoded 42 (backend.rs:315)

Upgrade lane: llama-cpp-2 0.1.133->0.1.152 (MTP spec decode, state_seq_save/load, fit_params, Windows CRT fix, llguidance; vendored source, no downloads); candle 0.8->0.11 (no default features, no hf-hub, clean); tract-onnx 0.23 pure-Rust ONNX bench candidate; ort BLOCKED by default download-binaries feature; burn/ratchet/kalosm/rustformers not candidates; no TRT-LLM bindings exist
